title: Report of a factory run (<out>/<run_id>/report.json, written by cmd/factory)
description: What a run spent and what it got for it. Cost per accepted change is the run's whole spend, failed and capped lanes included, divided by the lanes accepted (null when none was). Every lane carries the four token counters (input_tokens is the total prompt, cache included, as in run-defs cost; cache_read_input_tokens and cache_creation_input_tokens are parts of it; output_tokens), the turns, and the same figures per stage of its lite run, taken from the lane's own hash-chained ledger.json. A call that reported no cost counts in unreported_calls and adds nothing. total_usd of a later run counts the usd of every report found beside this one (prior_spend_usd).

calls.description: Role launches recorded in the ledger.

slice_id.description: null for a lane that never started.

branch.description: The lane's branch; kept after the lane, with its worktree removed.

status.description: accepted: a2dlc run ended PASS. rejected: it ended without PASS. skipped: precheck, spent nothing. capped: a cap stopped the lane or kept it from starting. killed: the run's kill or its context ended it. error: the factory could not run it.

run_outcome.description: state.json outcome of the lane's a2dlc run; null if it did not finish.

candidate_ref.description: Where the run left the builder's candidate commit; null unless accepted.

stages.description: One entry per stage of the lane's run, in stage order; empty for a lane that never started.

tests_touched.description: Present only on a rejected lane that modified or deleted a file that exists on the base and matches config.tests.paths. Adding test files is not listed. The lane is rejected as soon as the builder's call returns, before Tier 0 or the oracle run.

config_sha256.description: Hash of the factory.json bytes the run used.

outcome.description: completed: every lane ran or was skipped by precheck. stopped_new_lanes: run_stop_new_usd or total_usd kept a lane from starting. killed: run_kill_usd, total_usd or run_wall_seconds stopped the lanes in flight (see killed_by).

killed_by.description: Optional; present when outcome is killed. Which cap killed the run and how long the run had been going.

elapsed_seconds.description: Wall time from the start of the run to the kill.
